title: Supabase
text: supabase connector allows manage data stored Supabase PostgreSQL cloud. high-level functions : load_data() save_data() following parameters mandatory: api = "supabase" : indicate connector use. url: project url provided Supabase. Environment variable "SUPABASE_API_URL" can used. api_key*: API key provided Supabase. Environment variable "SUPABASE_API_KEY" used. table: name target table database. Environment variable "SUPABASE_TABLE" can used. Important Environment variables provided pass url, api_key table values. url & table variables considered optional single definition, api_key always passed environment variable hard coded anywhere.

title: Supabase
text: Specific parameter dedicated selecting (loading) data: query: provided, data target table loaded. See supabase_select() details.
code: # set environment Sys.setenv("SUPABASE_API_URL" = "https://<project_ref>.supabase.co/rest/v1/") Sys.setenv("SUPABASE_API_KEY" = "<api_key>")  # select all rows from table 'test' load_data(api = "supabase", table = "test")

title: Supabase
text: Specific parameter dedicated creating / updating data: data: data, data.frame object. upsert implemented, data.frame can mix new & updated rows single call. See supabase_upsert() details.
code: # set environment Sys.setenv("SUPABASE_API_URL" = "https://<project_ref>.supabase.co/rest/v1/") Sys.setenv("SUPABASE_API_KEY" = "<api_key>")  # insert rows (assuming the test table has id & comment attributes) save_data(api = "supabase", table = "test", data = data.frame(id = 2, comment = "test"))  # update rows save_data(api = "supabase", table = "test", data = data.frame(id = 2, comment = "update"))  # upsert rows save_data(api = "supabase", table = "test", data = data.frame(id = 2, comment = "update again"),                                             id = 3, comment = "new rows")

title: Supabase
text: Specific parameters dedicated deleting data: key: name primary key attribute, case “id”. values: index value(s) deleted.
code: # set environment Sys.setenv("SUPABASE_API_URL" = "https://<project_ref>.supabase.co/rest/v1/") Sys.setenv("SUPABASE_API_KEY" = "<api_key>")  # delete rows save_data(api = "supabase", table = "test", values = c(1, 2))

title: With Cache — with_cache
text: expr expression evaluate. path path cache folder. timeout numeric (hours) indicate cache content expired. force logical, cache content updated. limit numeric, cache size limit (Mb). cleanup character string numeric value (see details). encrypt logical, cache content encrypted. key character string, used secret. verbose logical, logs printed.

title: With Cache — with_cache
text: whatever evaluation expr produces.

title: With Cache — with_cache
text: Even though function designed work call_api(), principle work expression. single location used store cache content, "R_IKER_CACHE_PATH" recommended define path. force = TRUE, expression run even cache content expired. default cleanup set "auto". function check whether files cache older timeout. Obsolete files deleted. behavior can turned cleanup = "" tuned numeric value cleanup = 24 hours. default, encrypt set TRUE cache content encrypted. many APIs require key/token authentication method access resources. Setting encrypt = FALSE exposes content cache files. used APIs require authentication (open source geocoding service example). encrypt = TRUE, key mandatory encode/decode content cache. expected value character string need hashed. value used generate actual encryption key. said, key hard coded easy one find. rstring() function can used generate one, generated value needs saved passed "R_IKER_CACHE_KEY" environment variable. key lost, cache content lost.

title: With Cache — with_cache
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # set R_IKER_CACHE_PATH environment variable # set R_IKER_CACHE_KEY environment variable  # basic example: # first call will evaluate & return the current time with_cache(Sys.time(), verbose = T) # next calls will return cache content (for 8 hours) with_cache(Sys.time(), verbose = T) } # }
